mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participation (learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at) VALUES (#{learnerEnrollmentId}, #{status}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{trainingTime}, #{participationDate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE participation_date = #{participationDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY participation_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM learner_enrollment WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND participation_date = #{participationDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE participation SET status = #{status}, check_in = #{checkIn}, check_out = #{checkOut}, training_time = #{trainingTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM course c JOIN learner_enrollment le ON c.id = le.course_id WHERE c.is_in_progress = 1 AND le.completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(training_time), 0) FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.is_in_progress, c.name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.daily_hours, c.lesson_start_time, c.lesson_end_time, c.lunch_start_time, c.lunch_end_time, c.break_time, c.total_hours FROM course c JOIN learner_enrollment le ON c.id = le.course_id WHERE le.user_id = #{userId} AND le.completion_status = 'COMPLETED' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.end_date DESC

SELECT c.id, c.is_in_progress, c.name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.daily_hours, c.lesson_start_time, c.lesson_end_time, c.lunch_start_time, c.lunch_end_time, c.break_time, c.total_hours FROM course c JOIN learner_enrollment le ON c.id = le.course_id WHERE le.user_id = #{userId} AND le.completion_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.class_date) FROM course_schedule cs JOIN learner_enrollment le ON cs.course_id = le.course_id WHERE le.id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND cs.class_date <= CURDATE() AND le.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND training_time > 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND participation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY participation_date DESC

SELECT id, learner_enrollment_id, status, check_in, check_out, training_time, participation_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM participation WHERE participation_date < #{beforeDate} AND check_in IS NOT NULL AND check_out IS NULL AND status != 'VACATION' AND status != 'VACATION_PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.class_date) FROM course_schedule cs JOIN learner_enrollment le ON cs.course_id = le.course_id WHERE le.id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ATTENDANCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as attendanceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as lateCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LEAVE_EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as earlyCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as absenceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as vacationCount FROM participation WHERE learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND participation_date <= #{untilDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.class_date) FROM course_schedule cs JOIN learner_enrollment le ON cs.course_id = le.course_id JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id WHERE le.id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND cs.class_date >= c.start_date AND cs.class_date <= #{untilDate} AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.start_date as startDate, c.end_date as endDate, c.is_in_progress as isInProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id WHERE le.course_id = c.id AND p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING') AS pendingCount FROM course c JOIN staff_assignment sa ON c.id = sa.course_id WHERE sa.user_id = #{instructorId} AND c.is_in_progress = 1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND sa.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.start_date as startDate, c.end_date as endDate, c.is_in_progress as isInProgress FROM course c JOIN staff_assignment sa ON c.id = sa.course_id WHERE sa.user_id = #{instructorId} AND c.is_in_progress = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND sa.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.end_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id as participationId, DATE(p.participation_date) as vacationDate, p.created_at as applicationDate, u.fullname as learnerName, u.email as learnerEmail, pr.explanation as reason, pr.id as reasonId, c.name as courseName FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id as participationId, DATE(p.participation_date) as vacationDate, p.created_at as applicationDate, u.fullname as learnerName, u.email as learnerEmail, pr.explanation as reason, pr.id as reasonId, c.name as courseName FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND (p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' OR p.status = 'VACATION') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id as participationId, p.participation_date as vacationDate, p.created_at as applicationDate, p.status as status, u.fullname as learnerName, u.email as learnerEmail, pr.explanation as reason, pr.id as reasonId, c.name as courseName FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN participation_reason pr ON p.id = pr.participation_id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND (p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' OR p.status = 'VACATION') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND u.fullname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.status = 'VACATION' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND u.fullname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM participation p JOIN learner_enrollment le ON p.learner_enrollment_id = le.id JOIN user u ON le.user_id = u.id WHERE le.course_id = #{courseId} AND (p.status = 'VACATION_PENDING' OR p.status = 'VACATION') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND u.fullname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
